source.commit_message: fix(v2-06): close provider-free recovery and activation gaps

source_repairs.summary: Hosted Better Auth is now explicitly Google-only: email/password is disabled, email delivery configuration is removed, and the status/configuration policy exposes only Google.

Expired hosted leases, deadline-fenced requeues, device revocation, and Workflow expiry now append durable recovery events under database time and device-row locking; recovery cannot requeue work past its deadline.

The personal worker now validates exact result status and attempt lineage, observes cancellation through download/process/upload, bounds result bytes, and acknowledges completion only after the exact durable response.
source_repairs.release_truth: The separately recorded media-worker-v0.1.6 artifact remains unchanged; this source repair has not been rebuilt, published, or installed.

source_repairs.summary: Deployment and operations validation now requires protected PostgreSQL services with TLS/channel binding, rejects credential argv/passfiles, enforces exact grants and FORCE RLS checks, uses encrypted no-clobber backup envelopes, and applies an explicit secret allowlist and pinned rollback snapshot policy.
